generators.carrier: Nat (discrete step index k modulo period N)
Int × Int (Gaussian integers a+bi, Pythagorean rotation 3+4i)

relations.statement: (k + N) % N = k % N: a discrete N-periodic step index cannot distinguish k from k+N, so a finite clock aliases
Powers of the rational rotation (3+4i)/5 have nonzero imaginary numerators 4, 24, 44, ... so the rotation is not a root of unity and Z[i] is not a field; no rational angle logarithm exists
No Gaussian integer square root of the rotation 3+4i with norm compatibility: 5(a^2-b^2)=3d^2 and a^2+b^2=d^2 is obstructed
relations.hypotheses: a b d : Int, h_re : 5 * (a*a - b*b) = 3 * (d*d), h_norm : a*a + b*b = d*d

relations.statement: A discrete-time unitary step does not select a unique Stone generator (branch of logarithm ambiguity)
isSpacelike x y → isSpacelike y x on a FiniteStrictPoset; the causal datum is an external poset, not derived from Q(zeta_n) carriers

lemmas.statement: For all k N : Nat, (k + N) % N = k % N; the discrete clock aliases and so cannot encode a continuous time parameter
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem fq_stone_aliasing_restated (k N : Nat) : (k + N) % N = k % N := Nat.add_mod_right k N

lemmas.statement: (3+4i)^2 = -7+24i and (3+4i)^3 = -117+44i, exhibiting the nonzero imaginary parts 24 and 44 used in the infinite-order obstruction
The causal relation is supplied by a FiniteStrictPoset; spacelike separation is symmetric and irreflexive, but no construction from Q(zeta_n) data is claimed (GAP-C1000-001)

near_misses.claim: Because a finite clock aliases with period N, every rational unitary step must have finite order dividing N
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: pythagorean_infinite_order: (3+4i)/5 has rational entries yet (3+4i)^n is never real-times-5^n for n ≥ 1 (imaginary parts 4, 24, 44, ... nonzero)

near_misses.claim: The rotation (3+4i)/5 has a rational-entry square root, so continuous rational interpolation of time steps exists
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: half_exponent_obstruction: 5(a^2-b^2)=3d^2 with a^2+b^2=d^2 has no admissible integer solution

near_misses.claim: A discrete unitary step U uniquely determines the Hamiltonian H with U = exp(-iH)
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: discrete_generator_ambiguity: logarithm branch choice H + 2πk is not fixed by the discrete step

open_obligations: Strong continuity of a one-parameter unitary group t ↦ U(t) on R is not formalized; only the discrete-step countermodels are cited
Completion of Q(zeta_n) to R/C is a declared external import with no cited declaration
Generator mod_step and gaussian_mul rely on core Nat.mod and Int arithmetic; no @SRC declaration names these operations
GroupParameter.rotation_parameter_transcendental and time_parameter_transcendental were not inspected in detail and are not used in any relation here
Causal order datum: no generator produces an Event colour, so causal_le/spacelike admit no composition from the quantum carriers
